_note: Canonical proposals only per grammar/PRINCIPLES.md § 'The supervised-grammar-evolution proposal taxonomy'. Round 2 invented seven non-canonical proposal types; round 3 recasts. The eight canonical types are: NEW_TAG_PROPOSED, PAYLOAD_FIELD_PROPOSED, SEQUENCE_RULE_PROPOSED, INVARIANT_PROPOSED, TAG_SPLIT_PROPOSED, TAG_MERGE_PROPOSED, TAG_DEPRECATION_PROPOSED, ENTITY_MERGE_PROPOSED. Extension of the taxonomy is a Layer-10 grammar-growth change stamped at the kit-methodology level, not a move the Worker makes by writing new kinds inline. Pre-lock entity additions and rejections do not go through proposals.json at all — Step-1 Architect ratifies inline against signals/0.1.json § entity_implied_but_unnamed.flags[] and against direct removals from entities[].

proposals.rationale: Baselines (LinearBaseline, MLPBaseline, GRUBaseline, TargetOnlyVariant, MagnitudeWeightedVariant) and Ablations (ChannelMixerVariant, PatchNVariant, QuantileHeadVariant) share the Model lifecycle: same training loop, same checkpoint format, same eval metrics, same simulator interface. Distinguish at Layer 2 via a payload attribute `run_kind` on TrainingRun.
source_citations: tech-arch-v4.md §10 'Baselines — the ladder' + 'Architecture and target ablations'

proposals.rationale: The simulator consumes `p[t] ∈ ℝ^V` and derives `variance(p)`, `sharpness`, `p_up`, `expected_return` from it. Distribution names the object; Prediction names its role. One entity; the scalar derivations are payload fields at Layer 2.
source_citations: tech-arch-v4.md §11 'reads logits[:, -1, :] at the last position, softmaxes to p[t]'

proposals.rationale: One Layer-6 operator (the calibration scripts) writing to one directory (`artifacts/cost_calibration/`) that the simulator reads as one precondition ('required at simulator startup — hard fail'). The docs' lifecycle grouping favours one entity with two component fits; shortens the foreign-key graph Layer 2 traces.
source_citations: tech-arch-v4.md §11 'A missing calibration file is a hard failure'
